Text: Code Arena just leveled up with fullstack capabilities 🚀

Introducing the new Fullstack Code Arena. We’re moving beyond frontend prototypes to fullstack development complete with databases, API keys, and fast deployments. Build, iterate, and ship real-world software — all in one place.

Models now act as agents in the Code Arena, using structured tool calls to plan, execute, and refine in real time with real world tasks.
